confirmed_findings.mathematical_diagram_check: The statement diagram has horizontal short-exact rows with vertical maps f,g,h and corresponding commutative squares; the subsequent pullback P=B×_C K and pushout R=Q⨿_{A′}B′ maps are typed consistently with the displayed equations. The defect is rendering of the proof diagrams, not a detected mathematical mismatch.

editorial_candidates.reason: The example explicitly defines a concrete 3×3 diagram but currently states it in prose. A displayed diagram could make its row and column structure quicker to check; prose already specifies the data correctly, so this is not a defect.
editorial_candidates.diagram_data: Top row 0→0→0→0→0. Middle and bottom rows 0→Z/2 --i→ Z/4 --q→ Z/2→0, where i([x]₂)=[2x]₄ and q([x]₄)=[x]₂. Vertical maps from the zero row are zero; the three maps from middle to bottom are identities.
editorial_candidates.checks: Each square commutes: the upper squares have zero source row; the lower squares have identity vertical maps and identical row maps. Each column is 0→G→G→0 with its middle map 1_G, hence short exact. Both middle and bottom rows are the standard short exact sequence; the zero top row is short exact.
